findings.text: follow-on: the fragment stamps "Measured at 29e73a39f" while its contact rows are generated by compare.py's nova_contact landed at d82c053ee, so the revision a reader takes from the evidence disagrees with the commit that produced it.

follow-on: the assertion compares contact["position"][0] against row["nova_admitted_point"][0], both built in join_side from the same n["nova_saddle_r"], so the two sides move together and hold while nova_contact reads that field; only the adjacent assertIsNotNone catches the pre-fix None position.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base a0ed032e1; three commits add the comparison module and its tests, revise plot.py to draw per-loop walls and the escape marker, and land the contact-level repair and the new structural guards, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: brief.txt requires (1) a 26-side table with axes flagged and loop counts, (2) one diagnosis per disagreement, (3) figures redrawn with the per-loop wall and the escape bottleneck; docs/research/efit-escape-level-comparison.html:33-63 has the table with the 301-302:B tracked-maximum flag, :70-89 the diagnoses, and the five SVGs under docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/efit-axis-adjudication each carry the escape marker (checked for the #b0182b mark) and separate obstacle loops.
item_verdicts.goal: brief.txt asks for a rule-against-rule comparison of nova's boundary read and imas-efit's escape level on 26 trace sides plus redrawn per-loop panels; scripts/prototypes/efit_escape_comparison/compare.py:115 builds those 26 rows and docs/research/efit-escape-level-comparison.html carries the table, agreement summary, diagnoses and panels.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete at head d82c053ee, the after_suite gate (12 passed, 0 failed) and the baseline arm (1 passed), and a negative_control_log whose reverting of compare.py leaves 8 focused tests failing and of plot.py leaves 2.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the six paths granted in brief.txt are scripts/prototypes/efit_escape_comparison, scripts/prototypes/efit_axis_adjudication, docs/research/efit-escape-level-comparison.html, docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/efit-axis-adjudication and docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/efit-escape-level-comparison.html; every path in the base-to-head diff lies inside them.

justifications.durability: scripts/prototypes/efit_escape_comparison/test_compare.py:87 asserts a limited row's contact level is not the wall extremum, an independent field, and reddens when the pre-fix contact-level choice is reinstated.
justifications.evidence: the after_suite at d82c053ee (12 passed, 0 failed) and the negative_control_log that reddens on reverting compare.py record the gate rather than assert it, though the fragment's revision stamp is stale (see finding at docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/efit-escape-level-comparison.html:25).
justifications.fit: plot.py:143 _wall_loops_by_role and compare.py:129 nova_contact follow the surrounding prototype style and introduce no forbidden plan or version name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/efit_escape_comparison/compare.py:141 now reports a limited row's contact at nova's own boundary level with the position reading.boundary admitted, repairing the four MAST-U rows the two prior reviews flagged.
justifications.reuse: plot.py:161 imports efit_field_swap.crosscheck.domain_rings rather than copying it (the duplication the prior review named at the old line 146), and a search over scripts/ and nova/ found no other owner of the escape-level comparison or of a shared research-page builder these prototypes should extend.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (compare.py, plot.py, the two test files and the three docs) is inside the write paths declared in the source manifest line 3.
